Admin routes of the storefront module. Every route needs a staff session and the permission named on it; send `X-Resolve-Locale: false` to receive every locale of a translatable field for editing.

## GET /v1/admin/storefront/pages

Get storefront pages

Responses:

- `200`: Pages retrieved.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.

## GET /v1/admin/storefront/pages/{pageSlug}/sections

Get page sections (admin)

Parameters:

- `pageSlug` in path (string, required).
- `page` in query (number, min 1, optional).
- `pageSize` in query (number, min 1, max 100, optional).

Responses:

- `200`: Sections retrieved.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.

## POST /v1/admin/storefront/pages/{pageSlug}/sections

Create section

Parameters:

- `pageSlug` in path (string, required).

Request body: [CreateSectionAdminDto](#createsectionadmindto).

Responses:

- `201`: Section created.
- `400`: Invalid input.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.

## PATCH /v1/admin/storefront/pages/{pageSlug}/sections/reorder

Reorder sections

Parameters:

- `pageSlug` in path (string, required).

Request body: [ReorderSectionsAdminDto](#reordersectionsadmindto).

Responses:

- `204`: Sections reordered.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.

## GET /v1/admin/storefront/public-config

Public storefront origin and product URL shape

Responses:

- `200`: Config returned.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.

## DELETE /v1/admin/storefront/sections/{id}

Delete section

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Responses:

- `204`: Section deleted.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.
- `404`: Section not found.

## PATCH /v1/admin/storefront/sections/{id}

Update section

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Request body: [UpdateSectionAdminDto](#updatesectionadmindto).

Responses:

- `200`: Section updated.
- `400`: Invalid input.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.
- `404`: Section not found.

## PATCH /v1/admin/storefront/sections/{id}/visibility

Toggle section visibility

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Request body: [ToggleVisibilityAdminDto](#togglevisibilityadmindto).

Responses:

- `200`: Visibility toggled.
- `400`: Invalid input.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.
- `404`: Section not found.

## Schemas

### CreateSectionAdminDto

- `pageSlug` (string, pattern `/^[a-z0-9-/]+$/`, max length 200, optional).
- `type` (`"HERO"`, `"PROMOTIONAL_BANNER"`, `"CATEGORY_SHOWCASE"`, `"FEATURED_PRODUCTS"`, `"TRUST_SIGNALS"`, required).
- `title` ([TranslatableDto](#translatabledto), optional).
- `config` (object, required).
- `sortOrder` (number, min 0, optional).
- `isVisible` (boolean, optional).
- `visibleFrom` (string, optional).
- `visibleUntil` (string, optional).

### ReorderSectionsAdminDto

- `orderedIds` (array of string, required).

### ToggleVisibilityAdminDto

- `isVisible` (boolean, required).
- `visibleFrom` (string, optional).
- `visibleUntil` (string, optional).

### TranslatableDto

- `fr` (string, optional).
- `en` (string, optional).
- `ar` (string, optional).
- `default` (string, required).
